description: Offline conformance vectors. Paths are relative to this manifest.

cases.purpose: Confirmed intake contains no authoritative scope or actor.
RETEST pins defect, source build and an immutable EXTERNAL_HISTORICAL prior Session before US2 QA Session tables exist.
Published project context pins an exact risk policy and human publication provenance.
Hashed scoped risk policy declares exact verdict, waiver, accepted-risk and final-close permission keys.
Immutable Required Session Plan revision.
US1 request extension is valid before US2 publishes its optional exact plan pointer.
Initial append-only input revision may omit DoR semantics and record MISSING server-derived response channel so post-confirmation NEEDS_INFO remains reachable.
Pointer advance event exposes exact prior/new revisions and atomically invalidated assessment/waiver/pending READY refs.
Immutable readiness revision carries exact version and content hash.
Sparse confirmed input revision yields structured NEEDS_INFO for missing original-requester channel, declarations and Binding rather than failing structural confirmation.
Confirmed readiness remains a fact after Core advances from READY to DONE and retains exact command/result provenance.
DOR waiver pins exact subject, qa.dor rule, input fingerprint, expiry, scoped risk policy and distinct QA Lead decision.
Public PLAN_ITEM waiver selection accepts only a same-scope ID; the server resolves its current resource version and snapshot.
REQUIRED_SESSION waiver selection pins one exact requirement inside one immutable Required Session Plan revision.
Manual Session pins the exact Required Session Plan requirement and complete human state provenance.
Append-only human Session review pins the adjudicative manifest revision.
Append-only ManualAttempt uses canonical attempt result.
A clean PASS starts with one exact finalized PASS Attempt in contiguous server-derived history.
Clean PASS has a current-leaf POSITIVE Observation with structured expected and actual outcomes on that exact PASS Attempt.
Before review, an audited correction creates a new Observation leaf and makes the exact predecessor stale for result CAS.
CANCELLED remains a terminal ManualAttempt result and carries a bounded human cancellation reason.
FAIL carries unconditional attachment evidence.
Persisted clean PASS exposes the complete server-derived finalized Attempt and current-leaf Observation memberships.
The public result command carries only expected complete-set CAS fingerprints/counts, never caller-selected Attempt or Observation refs.
Every executed result, including clean PASS, requires a nonempty exact current-leaf Observation set.
PLAN_ITEM waiver produces an honest NOT_RUN result over the exact approved waiver and an empty Attempt set.
Scoped attachment initiation records declared checksum, media type, size and classification without a provider locator.
Current EvidenceArtifactLink reports AVAILABLE after authenticated finalize.
Signed manifest member freezes checksum and availability-at-signing in immutable hashed bytes.
Later live projection reports EXPIRED and still points to the same immutable manifest-member content hash validated by the preceding fixture.
Frozen PRODUCT review records CREATE_DEFECT intent; a later DefectLink is not part of the signed manifest.
Post-DONE clerical revision is explicitly non-adjudicative and changes only display text.
Marker points to the new revision and unchanged adjudicative revision.
Classification-only Finding review exists before any disposition fields.
DUPLICATE is normalized to one exact existing defect ref plus the human disposition reason.
FINDING waiver pins exact scoped risk policy and distinct-Lead generic action provenance.
WAIVED Finding review requires the exact generic waiver action while retaining evidence membership.
Frozen Finding header projects the same exact waived review and waiver action.
Optional wording-only proposal is non-authoritative and pins one exact frozen Finding review before human acceptance.
Human rejection is immutable and requires reason/actor/time with zero external call.
Wording replacement may invalidate a DRAFT head while preserving its exact zero-acceptance projection.
Wording replacement may invalidate a READY_FOR_APPROVAL head and preserves human acceptance provenance.
INVALIDATED from READY_FOR_APPROVAL cannot erase predecessor-owned acceptance provenance.
REJECTED from READY_FOR_APPROVAL preserves exact acceptance provenance and has zero delivery side effects.
REJECTED from READY_FOR_APPROVAL cannot omit predecessor-owned acceptedBy/acceptedAt.
Late immutable DefectLink pins the frozen review, generic approval/command/receipt traversal and human confirmation basis.
request.create asks for canonical NEW.
Structurally confirmed request maps the non-empty human title to summary while absent goal/outcome remain omitted, never fabricated.
DONE transition pins exact plan, verdict and DoD refs.
Vendor-neutral defect.create input.
Declared mock BACKLOG raw state maps to canonical NEW.
Generic confirmation derives canonical DONE from raw CLOSED.
Signed Verdict pins all reviewed sessions, adjudicative manifests, frozen Findings and exact policy versions.
Verdict has no INVALIDATED state; upstream drift leaves historical SIGNED content and stales only the current selector.
READY_TO_CLOSE is evaluated before candidate creation and therefore forbids a completion candidate pin.
BLOCKED can honestly inventory missing Verdict, required Session reviews and adjudicative evidence instead of requiring the inputs whose absence it reports.
Candidate lifecycle reaches CONFIRMED only after its separate final-close confirmation exists.
Generic confirmation records raw state and derives canonical DONE without mutating the candidate payload.
Final append-only DoD SATISFIED pins the confirmed candidate, command, result and external version.
Final event carries generic approval ref and derived DONE.
Client-supplied Workspace scope is forbidden.
Client cannot forge or select the authoritative exact response-channel ref; the server resolves PLATFORM_WEB.
Input revision cannot be committed after READY dispatch/in-flight wins the shared aggregate CAS.
Feature 002 accepts MANUAL sessions only.
A non-COMPLETED Session cannot expose outcome or signed review/evidence projection fields.
READY requires complete target/scope snapshot refs and hashes before RUNNING freezes them.
Session start guard cannot use a TargetSnapshot without exact test-data and account-lease inputs.
Plan Item FAIL cannot be used as a ManualAttempt result.
A terminal CANCELLED attempt cannot omit its reason.
FR-014 rejects negative outcomes without evidence and has no waiver escape.
PLANNED or RUNNING Plan Items cannot expose an adjudicative result revision.
An executed TERMINAL item requires its result and forbids waiver projection; only WAIVED carries both.
A later passing retry never erases the per-attempt evidence obligation for an earlier executed negative attempt.
A DUPLICATE disposition cannot retain only an existing defect ref while omitting the human normalization reason.
Provider locator is forbidden in canonical evidence metadata.
EVIDENCE is not a legal waiver kind.
A REQUIRED_SESSION selector cannot masquerade as the PLAN_ITEM ID selector branch.
Feature 002 has no DOD waiver; every pre-close DoD blocker is non-waivable.
READY_TO_CLOSE requires a signed Verdict and nonempty exact Session-review and adjudicative-manifest inputs.
DoD pins an exact immutable QaWaiver decision; a generic platform action is only transitive provenance and cannot replace it.
Only PROJECT_REGISTRY_NEEDS_REVIEW is waivable in DoR; content, declaration, target, security, entitlement, channel, RETEST and mapping blockers are not.
Pre-waiver NEEDS_INFO may report NEEDS_REVIEW without a ref, but READY_WITH_WAIVER requires the exact approved DoR waiver.
NEEDS_INFO is a QA assessment state, not a Core normalized status in feature 002.
READY_PENDING_SYNC requires the exact READY command and remains Core NEW.
The explicit 002 SYNC_ERROR projection retains command+error but does not expose an unconfirmed result.
Mutable embedded session plan cannot replace the exact revision ref.
read-back is a generic confirmation strategy, not a fourth operation.
BACKLOG may appear only as rawExternalState, never canonical normalizedStatus.
DONE transition must carry the closed structured completion summary, not only its digest.
READY transition must not carry terminal completion-summary content.
DONE cannot omit the exact Required Session Plan revision.
CONFIRMED is a successful generic close and therefore forbids terminalReason.
FAILED is post-dispatch and must preserve approval, actor/time, command and effect-key provenance.
Jira-specific field is forbidden in the vendor-neutral capability.
Project-scoped envelope cannot omit projectId.
Stable empty plan header exposes the INITIAL publication CAS state.
Revision two carries unchanged requirement lineage and separately waives another requirement.
Public human input revision includes code and bounded free text.
Public revision cannot omit its human reason.
Persisted revision two requires changeReason.
INITIAL publication has a null predecessor.
Revision publication pins the current plan.
INITIAL forbids an existing current plan.
Non-initial publication requires its predecessor.
Initial result has null predecessor and no correction reason.
Initial result forbids orphan correction reason.
Correction requires a reason.
DoD can derive blockers before plan or Verdict exists.
READY assertion pins exact closure hints.
READY assertion cannot omit closure hints.
BLOCKED preserves RUNNING milestones.
A pre-start edit advances structureRevision/hash and atomically resets READY to PLANNED with STRUCTURE_CHANGED provenance.
PLANNED cannot retain a non-null readyAgainstStructureHash after a structural edit.
PLANNED interruption forbids future milestones.
UPLOAD_PENDING forbids upload projection.
Accepted-risk action exists iff its disposition applies.
Note-only clerical annotation is signed and hash-covered.
INITIAL forbids clerical annotations.
Display annotation requires an artifact target.
DRAFT forbids acceptance projection.
REJECTED forbids delivery refs.
Post-dispatch FAILED preserves effect key.
Primary signature matches the signed Verdict.
Ordinary risk forbids partial signature state.
Elevated risk SIGNED requires two signatures.
SUPERSEDED preserves signed provenance.
Verdict v1 forbids incoming lineage.
Supersession reason exists only on SUPERSEDED.
PENDING waiver forbids decision provenance.
Session event preserves RUNNING to BLOCKED provenance.
Session event rejects illegal state jump.
Terminal event milestone equals predecessor.
Input revision event carries reason.
INITIAL plan event forbids previous ref.
Elevated-risk event carries two signatures.
Accepted-risk event requires action.
BLOCKED DoD event may omit missing plan.
READY DoD event requires plan.
Post-close event carries annotations and authority.
AUTHORIZED invalidation preserves approval provenance.
AUTHORIZED invalidation cannot drop actor/time.
Invalidation after dispatch is forbidden.
LINKED defect pins draft and link.
Rejected publication pins rejection.
LINKED cannot omit link.
Non-create disposition forbids draft/link.
DUPLICATE requires existing defect ref.
A published plan must retain at least one REQUIRED slot; last-required waiver is rejected.
A later plan revision retains the historical READY proof but cannot publish against a current DONE/frozen operational projection.
OPEN extension guard permits a same-CAS adjudicative mutation.
DISPATCHED guard pins exact candidate, command, aggregate hash and lock time before outbox publication.
Confirmed external DONE preserves dispatch provenance and freezes the aggregate.
An in-flight completion guard cannot omit the locked aggregate hash.
DISPATCHED candidate preserves exact approval, command and effect provenance.
FAILED preserves dispatched provenance while the extension guard is released back to OPEN.
Only the server-derived current Executor role may initiate final close.
A QA Lead may approve final close but cannot initiate it.
Fail-to-pass result pins the current DISPOSED review before Session review freezes its successor.
PASS + FLAKY_SUSPECTED result revision pins exact current DISPOSED Finding basis and negative evidence.
The result command pins the same exact DISPOSED basis as its durable revision.
PASS + FLAKY_SUSPECTED cannot omit the exact current DISPOSED basis.
US3 INCONCLUSIVE remains recordable without a future Finding freeze dependency.
INCONCLUSIVE forbids a flaky disposition basis.
Session review pins the unchanged DISPOSED review and its atomically created FROZEN successor.
The duplicate review chain starts with a classification-only version 1.
The exact Finding waiver is first recorded on a DISPOSED successor before a separate FROZEN revision.
A DISPOSED review cannot be version 1 or omit its exact CLASSIFIED predecessor.
FLAKY_SUSPECTED is not legal on FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT_RUN results.
FAIL, BLOCKED and INCONCLUSIVE require at least one exact considered Observation.
The result event serializes the complete server-derived Attempt membership plus exact current-leaf Observation and flaky-disposition lineage.
The signed manifest preserves the bounded reason for a cancelled ManualAttempt.
A CANCELLED attempt lineage cannot omit its durable cancellation reason.
Non-cancelled attempt lineage forbids a stray cancellation reason.
An active same-Session Observation assignment has server-derived human provenance and no release projection.
A considered negative Observation is an immutable same-PlanItem leaf that names the exact failed Attempt.
A later positive Observation remains distinct and cannot erase the earlier negative Attempt lineage.
The exact negative Observation is actively assigned to the disposed Finding pinned by a flaky PASS basis.
Release is a one-way audited projection; reassignment creates a new row.
A released membership cannot omit its bounded human release reason.
One atomic Session-reviewed event carries the complete exact set of Finding reviews frozen with the manifest.
Session-reviewed events cannot omit the complete frozen-Finding set; clean US3 emits an explicit empty array.
A later HUMAN revision command carries only mutable DoR semantics plus CAS and reason.
Client attempts to rewrite frozen title, request kind or classification are structurally rejected.
HUMAN REJECTED is solely the exact generic Approval rejection of an AWAITING_APPROVAL candidate.
CANDIDATE has no human discard route and cannot become REJECTED without an exact generic Approval.
